<thought>To determine the number of methyl groups, I will first obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample using the carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Then I will identify peaks in the typical methyl carbon region (≈10‑30 ppm) using the known shift ranges for methyl carbons. This will allow me to count the methyl groups without unnecessary additional measurements.</thought>
